target.title: improve: speed timing-sensitive tests and fix LOC ratchet CI
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Several timing-sensitive tests spend real wall-clock time waiting for debounce, hover, reconnect, and lifecycle windows. The waits add more than 13 seconds to focused Control UI feedback and about half a second to the managed-process test file. Separately, the new TypeScript LOC ratchet reports baseline drift already present in the PR base, causing unrelated PRs to fail `check-guards`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use Playwright's controlled page clock for six browser timing windows, keeping the tested delays intact without sleeping. End the parallel managed-child fixture explicitly once its listener invariant has been observed instead of waiting for natural process exit. Scope LOC violations to the already-detected changed-path set; baseline-file edits still trigger full-repository validation. Carry that set through a temporary JSON file so large changes cannot exceed the process argument limit. For pull requests, derive the LOC base from the checked-out synthetic merge commit's first parent, which remains exact when the event payload is stale and the checkout is shallow. Remove four newly exposed, unused UI type exports so the dependency guard remains green.

## User Impact

No runtime or user-visible behavior changes. Developers get materially faster test feedback with the same assertions and timing semantics, while CI assigns LOC debt to the change that introduces it.

## Evidence

- Same-box before/after profiling for the six optimized UI assertions: 25.38 s -> 12.25 s (51.7% faster).
- Same-box managed-child file profiling: 635.0 ms -> 114.7 ms (82% faster).
- Pre-rebase exact-head proof: managed-child file 9/9 passed in 145 ms (`run_f7e1f8582f6f`); six focused UI assertions 6/6 passed in 13.86 s (`run_f3fee8e10569`).
- Broad changed-surface gate passed (`run_49ead66732aa`).
- Post-rebase tooling proof: 174/174 tests passed on Testbox `tbx_01kxctqfm2ddeqqg347919wksc` ([run 29223304924](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29223304924)); managed-child finished in 89 ms.
- All six optimized UI assertions passed post-rebase. The run also exposed a current-main duplicate-name selector; the intended sidebar control plus the changed chat-flow timing case passed 2/2 after repair.
- `pnpm deadcode:exports` matched all 5,512 baseline entries; `pnpm check:workflows` passed.
- Final 16-file `pnpm check:changed` gate passed, including formatting, four affected typecheck lanes, and lint (Testbox command 28.77 s).
- Fresh autoreview is clean after the CI hardening (`patch is correct`, confidence 0.87) and after the final selector/baseline cleanup (`patch is correct`, confidence 0.91).

AI-assisted: yes.
